exposure: glycaemic control (HbA1c) measured at first antenatal visit, 14, 20, and 36 weeks' gestation
fetal anterior abdominal wall thickness (AAW) measured at 30, 33, and 36 weeks' gestation
fetal abdominal circumference (AC) measured at 30, 33, and 36 weeks' gestation
fetal anterior abdominal wall thickness:abdominal circumference (AAW:AC) ratio
outcome: fetal macrosomia (defined as >90th centile birth weight based on gestational age and gender)
cohort: The study included 416 pregnancies of women with pre-gestational diabetes from a tertiary referral maternity hospital.
finding: Abdominal circumference at 36 weeks was the single best predictor of fetal macrosomia, and a combined model using HbA1c, AC, and AAW measurements provided the best antenatal prediction of macrosomia.
